change.summary: Added a test-local serializer for generated ACIS BinaryFile 21800 graph tokens and exercised the complex rooted graph through parse/build/project. Compared semantic pointer rows and projection reachability, graph links, loop order, cycle counters, unsupported branch counters, and exact outside-root counts for an unreachable vertex/edge/face against the in-memory control. Accounted for the explicit terminal node in the parsed graph.

evidenceCeiling: Generated 21800 transport, shared-prefix alignment, graph-reference rows, ordered rooted topology traversal, cycles, unsupported-branch accounting, outside-root counts, and terminal-marker retention only. This does not validate arbitrary SAB grammar, ACIS B-rep semantics, units/transforms, DWG AcDs association, or native consumers.
